db_server_info.title: Database serverinfo

wp_version.title: WordPress versie
wp_version.description: De WordPress core versie die op deze website draait.

language.title: Websitetaal

version.title: WordPress versie

fields.description: Optioneel: beperk het antwoord tot specifieke velden. Als dit wordt weggelaten, worden alle velden geretourneerd.

wp-rocket\/add-page-insights.name: wp-rocket/add-page-insights
wp-rocket\/add-page-insights.label: Add Page Insights
wp-rocket\/add-page-insights.description:
Adds a URL to Rocket Insights monitoring. Requires a valid URI.
Use this when the user wants to monitor a new page. Do not use it when the page is already monitored; use retest-page-insights instead.
Confirm the exact URL with the user before calling. This action is non-idempotent, so calling it twice for the same URL may return an error.
On success, tell the user the first score may take a few minutes and offer to trigger an immediate test with retest-page-insights Recheck every minute in the background and poll results with get-page-insights-score.

success.description: Indicates whether the page was successfully added

error.description: Error message if the page could not be added

wp-rocket\/clear-url-cache.name: wp-rocket/clear-url-cache
wp-rocket\/clear-url-cache.label: Clear URL cache
wp-rocket\/clear-url-cache.description: Clears WP Rocket cache for specific URL(s), not a full purge. Before calling: list the URL(s), ask "Confirm you want to clear cache for this url?" (use "these" if plural), and wait for a yes in the same turn. On success (success: true, error empty): say the cache was cleared and will regenerate on next visit. On failure: error is an object of url => reason; report each failed URL with its own reason, not a generic message.

url.description: A single URL or an array of URLs whose cache should be purged.

success.description: Indicates whether the url cache was succesfully purged

error.description: Object keyed by URL for each URL whose cache could not be purged, with the reason as the value.

wp-rocket\/clear-website-cache.name: wp-rocket/clear-website-cache
wp-rocket\/clear-website-cache.label: Clear website cache
wp-rocket\/clear-website-cache.description: Clears the full WP Rocket cache for the entire website. Use this when the user asks to clear, purge, or refresh all cached pages for the site. This is a site-wide destructive cache action. Do not use it for a single page; use clear-url-cache instead. Confirmation is required before calling

success.description: Indicates whether the website cache was successfully cleared

error.description: Reason the cache could not be cleared, empty on success.

wp-rocket\/get-cache-health.name: wp-rocket/get-cache-health
wp-rocket\/get-cache-health.label: Get WP Rocket cache health
wp-rocket\/get-cache-health.description:
Returns sitewide Preload queue counts (pending, in-progress, completed, failed) and an estimated time remaining until preloading finishes.
The estimate is always a projection (is_estimate is always true), based on the configured maximum batch size and cron interval, not a live measurement. Use this to answer "is my cache warm" or "how long until preload finishes".
If tracking_enabled is false, tell the user Preload tracking is disabled rather than presenting a stale or empty estimate as current.

wp-rocket\/get-cache-status.name: wp-rocket/get-cache-status
wp-rocket\/get-cache-status.label: Get WP Rocket cache status
wp-rocket\/get-cache-status.description:
Returns the Preload queue status for one URL, post, or term: tracked, status (pending, in-progress, completed, or failed), modified, and last_accessed.
Provide exactly one of url, post_id, or term_id together with taxonomy. This reports Preload queue tracking, not a raw filesystem check.
If tracked is false, tell the user the URL is not currently tracked by Preload (tracking may be disabled, or the URL was excluded or not crawled yet) rather than implying the page is not cached.
